extDescription.message: Shows Outlook web calendar reminders as system notifications. Reads only what the page displays; no network access.

optionEnabled.message: Show system notifications for Outlook reminders

optionKeepImminent.message: Keep notifications for imminent meetings (≤ 5 min) on screen until clicked

optionDebug.message: Debug mode: log detected reminders to the Outlook page console (contains meeting details)
